name: NordLayer
summary: NordLayer sells business VPN access per user, with a five-user minimum on every self-serve plan. Its Core and Premium plans require a dedicated IP server, which adds $40 a month for the whole company rather than per user. Admins manage users from one control panel and can connect Entra ID or Okta.

facts.text: NordLayer says it uses AES-256 and ChaCha20 encryption to protect business data.
The Core and Premium plans require a Server with Dedicated IP add-on at $40 a month, and the Lite plan does not include it.
Every self-serve plan has a five-user minimum, and the Enterprise offer starts at 200 users.
NordLayer states that its systems are ISO 27001 certified and have passed a SOC 2 Type 2 audit.
A 14-day money-back guarantee applies to the initial purchase, and cancelling stops auto-renewal at the end of the current period with no refund for unused time.

plans.name: Lite

plans.name: Core

plans.name: Premium

plans.name: Enterprise offer
plans.notes: From $6 with Lite capabilities, minimum 200 users, and the price may vary with higher plans or added features.

hiddenCosts: Taxes such as VAT or sales tax are added to the listed USD prices.
Dedicated IP is custom-priced on the Enterprise offer.

contract.cancellation: Cancelling turns off automatic renewal and takes effect at the end of the current period, with no refund for unused time. A 14-day money-back guarantee applies to the initial purchase.
